ARCS kitMolecule 44status-strip

Status Strip

Say in one line where the work stands: not started and what is next, or which day it is, how many hours are done and what waits on the reader.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1Not startedBold Not started. before any progress; never an empty 0% bartext
2Day segmentsOne 18px segment per plan day; done days filled, today half filled; role=progressbarcyan, empty border
3Day and hoursDay N · X of Y hours done, tabular figurestext
4ItemsBold key then value: Up next:, Ready for your review:, Comments so far:key text, value text-secondary
5DetailsA details disclosure, only when something sits behind it (working on now, waiting on, latest)summary cyan

Usage

Use it when

  • A plan has days and hours and the reader wants to know, at a glance, where it stands and whether anything waits on them.
  • Show progress only once there is some; before that, Not started. and Up next say more than a 0% bar.
  • Placement: directly under the wordmark row and above the header strip, on every tab, with .is-top (one step smaller than the body text). It is engagement-wide status, not part of one tab's content.

Do not use it when

  • Do not show an empty bar, a percent, or a Details toggle with nothing behind it.
  • Do not repeat what the Now note above already says; the strip is the facts, the note is the action.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
days[]string[]yesPlan day labels, such as Before, Day 1 to Day 5, After; one segment each.
currentintegernoIndex of today in days; absent means not started.
hours_done, hours_totalnumbernoRendered as X of Y hours done.
nextstringyesThe next item, shown as Up next:.
review[]string[]noItems ready for the reader, with the date they became ready.
commentsintegernoCount of comments batched for the next review call.
details[]{key, text}noLines behind Details: working on now, waiting on, latest. No Details when empty.

Access

  • A labelled section with a visually hidden heading (Where things stand).
  • Segments carry role=progressbar with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and an aria-valuetext that reads the day and hours.
  • Meaning never rests on colour: the day and hours are also written out.
  • Details is a native details/summary, 44px tall. Text is rem, so the reading options scale it.
